claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Dublin (Br), from Liverpool May 5,
which arrived at this port yesterday, reports:—No deaths or [cut]
births on the passage; experienced strong westerly winds
the whole passage; the steamship City of Washington arrived
at Queenstown, with loss of rudder, in tow of steamship City
of Cork at 9 AM, May 7, having been towed 1002[?] miles; May
7, 31 miles W of Fastnet, exchanged signals with steamship
City of Boston; 20th, off Nantucket, exchanged night signals
with steamship City of Limerick.
